subject: English
passage: Environmental engineer Dr. Serwa Kyei and her research team believed they could enhance the effectiveness of the carbon capture polymer CaCO₃-PEI, an innovative mixture of calcium carbonate (CaCO₃) and polyethyleneimine (PEI), by incorporating graphene oxide ______ the modified polymer that emerged, CaCO₃-GO, proved to be a disappointing alternative to the original CaCO₃-PEI formula.
prompt: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanation: Choice B is the best answer. The convention being tested is the coordination of main clauses. This choice correctly uses a comma and the coordinating conjunction "but" to join the first main clause ("Environmental…GO") and the second main clause ("the modified…formula").
